Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to correctly interpret the search results regarding the date of the world record. Search Result 1 explicitly stated a world record of 1:48.030 set by "Vincent" on "2024-03-29". The agent ignored this much later date and incorrectly identified the March 9, 2023 record (1:48.585) as the one valid for June 7, 2023, failing to realize that a new record had been set in March 2024. This led to the final answer being incorrect.
